goal: Launch platform v1.0 on Product Hunt by October 1st
why: Prove I can ship a real product end-to-end and build income independent of my day job.

actions.text: Ship one scoped commit to main before 9 AM
Write one test for yesterday's code first thing
Close one open bug from the tracker
Timebox refactors to 90 minutes with a timer
Review the sprint board and cut scope if behind
Deploy to staging and click through the core flow
Read one page of the framework docs at lunch
Run the full test suite before signing off
Post one build-in-public update on X at 5 PM
Reply to 3 comments in the indie hackers forum
DM one potential beta user with a personal note
Draft one newsletter issue
Add one item to the launch-day asset checklist
Screenshot one new feature for the launch gallery
Log one competitor observation in the notes doc
Review analytics and write 3 takeaways
Send 2 customized outreach emails to target users
Log every piece of user feedback in the tracker
Ask one open-ended question in a user community
Run one 20-minute user interview
Tag yesterday's feedback by theme
Update the top-3 pain points list
Watch one session replay and note friction
Thank one user personally for their feedback
Walk 20 minutes outside before opening the laptop
Do a 15-minute strength circuit at 12:30 PM
Stop screens at 10 PM, lights out by 11
Drink water before each coffee
Prep 3 healthy lunches for the week
Stand and stretch at every pomodoro break
Log sleep hours in the tracker each morning
One longer run or hike
Block 8-11 AM as maker time on the calendar
Phone in the drawer during maker time
Write tomorrow's top task on a sticky note at shutdown
Batch email and Slack to 11 AM and 4 PM only
Log distractions in the interrupt list instead of acting
Review the interrupt list and prune commitments
Start each work block with a 2-minute intention note
End the day with a 5-minute shutdown ritual
Log every business expense the day it occurs
Review burn rate against the runway sheet
Skip one discretionary purchase and note the amount
Check subscription list and cancel one unused tool
Move 10% of any freelance income to the launch fund
Update the pricing-model doc with one new data point
Read one article on SaaS pricing at breakfast
Reconcile accounts
Write 3 lines in the journal about why this matters
Read the goal statement aloud after waking
Note one win, however small, before dinner
Meditate 10 minutes after the morning walk
Call one supportive friend or mentor
Reframe one negative thought in writing
Visualize launch day for 2 minutes before maker time
Review the failure-pattern list and pick one guard
Post progress in the accountability group at 6 PM
Ask one specific question of a more experienced builder
Help one person in the community with their problem
Co-working session with accountability partner
Tell my partner tonight's plan at breakfast
Thank one person who helped me this week
Log one piece of advice received and how I used it
Share one struggle honestly in the group

when_where.action: ship one scoped commit to main

when_where.location: the park loop by my house
my desk, right after shutdown ritual
the kitchen table during email batch

when_where.action: write 3 journal lines about why this matters
write tomorrow's top task on a sticky note
when_where.location: my monitor before closing the laptop

if_then.obstacle: I get stuck refactoring code for over 90 minutes
if_then.response: close my IDE and write my daily marketing post immediately

if_then.obstacle: I skip the morning walk two days in a row
if_then.response: put my running shoes next to the bed tonight and walk before checking any screen tomorrow

if_then.obstacle: a user gives harsh feedback and I feel like quitting
if_then.response: log the feedback verbatim in the tracker, close the tab, and reread my Why statement before responding
